newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds little changed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds little changed in light trade.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities prices slipped modestly on Friday, with spreads over Treasuries largely unchanged, traders said.
The market's recent calm persisted for most of the session, except for a flurry of activity late in the day.
"It seems there's been some sort of mortgage-to-Treasuries trade," one trader said at 1515 EST/2015 GMT. "It had been quiet until the last half hour."
Other traders could not confirm that maneuver, although they said a sudden weakness in certain Ginnie Mae coupons evidenced the trade.
Late Friday afternoon, mortgages were unchanged to off 2/32 overall, while comparable Treasuries were down 1/32 to 2/32.
In key coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was off 1/32 at 98-25/32, yielding 100 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac issues were down 1/32 as well, at 99-29/32 and 99-03/32, respectively.
The 10-year Treasury note was off 2/32 at 96-16/32 to yield 6.74 percent.
